cohort: 85 pregnant women with rheumatic heart disease admitted to a tertiary care center
finding: Functional cardiac status during pregnancy significantly impacts maternal and fetal outcomes in women with rheumatic heart disease.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery (58.82%) was the most common mode of delivery, followed by cesarean section (24.7%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight infants were found in 37.64% of cases.
